pm.test('list includes created student', () => { const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.some(s=>s.id===pm.collectionVariables.get('student_id'))).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('filter has target and no mismatches', () => { const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.some(s=>s.id===pm.collectionVariables.get('student_id'))).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.every(s=>s.academic_status==='active')).to.eql(true); });
